name: Temporal Anti-Aliasing with Anti-Smear
definition: A post-processing technique that blends current frame color with an accumulated history buffer using pixel velocity for reprojection, with an optional anti-smear feature that discards accumulated pixels with large depth differences to prevent ghosting.
summary: Temporal Anti-Aliasing with Anti-Smear blends frames using velocity reprojection and discards accumulated pixels with large depth differences to prevent static geometry from smearing across moving objects.
